name: Theocritus' Retrieval
objectiveText: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage. Faded Shadowhide Pendant (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: Glowing Shadowhide Pendant is a rare drop off shadow hide gnolls. If one drops, everyone in the party can loot.

Okay - after reading and reading still didn't know where the heck he was....

He is the Goldshire area (under Stormwind) in the Tower of Azora with coords of 65,70

ugh...
replies: Indeed. I do not know why this quest is listed as being in Redridge when anyone familiar with the Tower of Azora knows it is in Elwynn Forest. Did the Devs forget where they put it or did they get lazy, It should be corrected.

comments.body: This guy is at the top of the Tower of Azora in Elwyn Forest. The tower is on the road from Goldshire to Lakeshire.
Believe it's a random drop from gnolls near Fangore.
He is in the Tower of Azura in Elwynn Forest.
I found him at 65,69
I got it while collecting Shadowhide Pendants.

Quest is started by [url=/item=1962]"Glowing Shadowhide Pendant"[/url].

U can look it up and see who drops it and what the droprates are.
replies: Yeah and these droprates are just pathetic. Only 1% to start the quest? The people of Blizzard clearly have the intelligence of a Murloc.
